run_clang_format_diff: run clang-format diff on multiple C/C++ source files with parallel processing and unified diff output
review_clang_format_recursive: review C/C++ code formatting across directories recursively with clang-format and return diff output
build_clang_format_lint: build a CI-compatible clang-format linting tool that supports parallel jobs, colorized diffs, and exit codes
test_clang_format_extensions: test clang-format on specified file extensions with recursive directory traversal and glob-based exclusion patterns
summarize_clang_format_wrapper: summarize the clang-format diff wrapper that reads files, invokes clang-format, and produces colored unified diffs
